summary: Relay Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $175 million common stock offering. The issuer is offering shares at a price to be determined, with a 30-day underwriter option for an additional $26.25 million. Jefferies, TD Cowen, Goldman Sachs, and Guggenheim serve as joint book-running managers. This is a standard underwritten equity offering under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The filing lacks any change-of-control, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. A routine capital raise for a biotech firm with no event-driven angle.
